description: A geometry library for engineering drawings and models, in two dimensions and in three. Points, vectors, lines, polylines, polygons, faces with holes, circles and oriented rectangles in the plane; points, planes, triangles, polygons, faces, solids, boxes, coordinate systems and transformations in space. Over both: distance, projection, containment, intersection, collision, parallelism, parametrization, merging, splitting, extending and trimming, offsetting, and boolean operations. It also reads, writes and edits DXF drawings with AutoCAD's names, carries the label placement that arranges drawing labels clear of each other and of blocked regions, and packs boxes such as drawing views onto sheets of paper. Every comparison is tolerance-aware, because coordinates that come out of a BIM model are never exact.
releaseNotes:
NEW IN 13.7.0

      A minor release: one public member added, DxfDatabase.PatternSearchPath, and none removed or renamed. One fix is
      to the queries of solids far out; the rest is DXF parity with AutoCAD 2021, and the results callers will see
      change are listed under CHANGED.

      NEW, DXF
      - DxfDatabase.PatternSearchPath: folders, separated by semicolons and searched in their order, where the caller's
        own hatch pattern files are read from, as FontSearchPath gives the folders of the fonts. A HATCH given a pattern
        by SetHatchPattern is given its lines from there as AutoCAD 2021 gives them: from acadiso.pat in a drawing of
        millimetres and acad.pat in one of inches, or from a file named after the pattern, each line turned by
        PatternAngle and scaled by PatternScale and written anew when either is set, so that Explode() and
        GetHatchLinesData() draw it. ANSI31 of acadiso.pat on a square 30 by 20 holds its one line at 45 degrees and
        explodes to 11 LINEs. A file is read as AutoCAD reads one, a pattern AutoCAD refuses is refused, a pattern not
        found is left with no lines, as before, and a malformed file never throws. Every pattern of AutoCAD 2021's
        acad.pat and acadiso.pat at three scales and angles, 918 hatches, gives AutoCAD's own lines to 1E-13, and AUDIT
        finds nothing to fix. The library carries no pattern of AutoCAD's. Empty, as a drawing is opened or made,
        nothing is read and every drawing is written as before, to the byte.
      - An MTEXT of several lines is laid out in the fonts FontSearchPath finds as AutoCAD 2021 lays it out: its
        paragraphs wrapped at its width, its ActualWidth, ActualHeight and GeometricExtents, and the TEXTs Explode and a
        drawing of R12 give of it. A line breaks after the spaces between words and before or after a Chinese, Japanese
        or Korean letter, but not before a comma, a full stop or a closing bracket; a word longer than the width stays
        whole on a line of its own; spaced at least, each line stands a third of its height and a third of the MTEXT's
        height below the line before. Against AutoCAD 2021, paragraphs, widths, spacing, attachments, turns and styles
        come out as it gives them in 1 604 of 1 650 MTEXTs, breaks in 1 492 of 1 492, first and following lines in
        9 550 of 9 550, and codes and CJK letters in 789 of 789. Slanted letters, other fonts, stacks, indents and tabs
        are not measured. DxfMText.GeometricExtents is overridden; with an empty FontSearchPath nothing changes.
      - The big font of a text style (BigFontFileName) is read from FontSearchPath and its letters measured beside the
        style's SHX font as AutoCAD 2021 draws them: TEXT, ATTRIB and ATTDEF places and extents, one-line MTEXT sizes,
        multileaders landed on the right and attribute definitions in flips. A letter is read in the code page AutoCAD
        gives the big font's name (GBK for gbcbig.shx, Big5 for chineset.shx, Shift-JIS for bigfont and the extfont
        files, Korean for the four wh*.shx). Of 691 letters beside each of AutoCAD's ten CJK big fonts, all 6 910 are
        boxed as AutoCAD boxes them, and of the TEXTs in styles with a big font 15 382 of 15 450 give AutoCAD's place
        and box. On .NET the code pages need CodePagesEncodingProvider registered.

      FIXED, DXF
      - Beside a big font that is read, a TEXT stands at its bottom on the big font's depth, spaces are the big font's,
        and a TrueType style's big font, which AutoCAD does not draw, no longer leaves its TEXTs at their bottom
        unplaced: of 5 400 TEXTs of txt.shx and gbcbig.shx, 3 692 gave AutoCAD's place and box and 5 156 do.
      - DxfDatabase.SummaryInfo of a drawing of R2000 reads every custom property AutoCAD 2021 saved, and writes more
        than ten as AutoCAD does, where it read ten and refused an eleventh. A drawing of ten or fewer is written as
        before, to the byte.
      - A block given an attribute definition by DxfBlockTableRecord.AppendEntity is marked as one of attribute
        definitions (flag 2 of its BLOCK, HasAttributeDefinitions), as AutoCAD 2021 marks one, and the mark is kept when
        the definition is erased. Without it AutoCAD took a block made in code for one of no attribute: the value a
        multileader gave the block's attribute was lost, and its EXPLODE gave the INSERT no ATTRIB. These two fixes
        come of the checklist of DXF held against AutoCAD 2021, of which 23 points are settled against it.

      FIXED, solids
      - Where a point, a ray, a segment or a line stands against a solid far out is worked out near the origin, as its
        booleans and its measures are: Locate, Contains, DistanceTo, SignedDistanceTo, GetClosestPointOnBoundary and
        GetShortestLineTo of a point, and CollidesWith, DistanceTo, GetIntersections and GetShortestLineTo of a ray, a
        segment and a line, on GeoSolid3, GeoPreparedSolid3 and the shapes asked of it, move a body reaching more than
        2^20 out and more than 1 024 times the size of its box into the frame of the booleans, once, and the probe with
        it. Of 18 000 points, rays, segments and lines beside bodies ten million to a thousand million out, wrong
        answers at a hundredth, a thousandth and a millionth 209 -> 67, and 1 284 -> 9 of probes the tolerance itself
        off a face. Within a million of the origin nothing changed, to the bit. Far out the first question of a body
        takes 2 to 14 microseconds to move it; after that each takes as long as before.

      CHANGED, DXF: results callers will see change
      - Where its fonts are measured, an MTEXT of one line spaced exactly is as high as AutoCAD 2021 makes it, its
        height and a third ("ABC" of txt.shx 4 high is 5.333 high, not 4), and one whose words wrap, or that holds \T,
        \A, \L, \O, \K, \C or \~, is measured where it kept the file's 42 and 43. Reading a one-line ActualWidth with
        fonts takes 13.8 microseconds where it took 11.3 for txt.shx on .NET Framework 4.8; nothing changes without
        fonts.
      - A block given an attribute definition in code writes flag 2 in its BLOCK, where it wrote none; a block read
        from a file says what its file says.

      Details in CHANGELOG.md.

      Earlier releases: https://github.com/nguyenthanguth/GeometryHelper/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
